content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms exclude indemnification obligations from the liability cap, which could expose me to unlimited financial liability. I propose modifying this section to remove the indemnification exclusion so that the limitation applies consistently. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
